name: Orbit constellation
description: Twenty-eight cropped captures spin on a ring, then fly into a constellation web as you scroll; drag to spin, hover to follow a thread, filter by panel and open any frame.

default.failed: The full capture did not load. The card preview stays.

propDocs.frames: Array of {title, series, source, x, y, w} in ring order. series is an index into the panel names, source is a key of the source captures, x and y are the crop origin and w the crop width as fractions of the capture.
propDocs.sources: Object keyed by source id: {dark: [small url, large url], light: [small url, large url], w, h, name, alt}.
propDocs.series: Panel names in order; chips and the lightbox use them.
propDocs.labels: Text shown by the component: readout, loader, lightbox and screen reader labels.
propDocs.filterVariable: Name of the text variable the filter chips set: all, or a panel index such as 3.
propDocs.shuffleVariable: Name of the number variable whose change reshuffles the web.

fallback: Without 3D transforms the stage becomes a plain grid of the same frames that opens the same viewer. With reduced motion the ring and the web cross-fade at the chapter break and the loop idles.
